title: Step 1 - R Tutorial: Creating a Decision Tree Classifier with rpart Library

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: So we'll quickly set our folder as working directory, part tree classification.
cues.zh: 快速把資料夾設為工作目錄，Part 3 Classification。

cues.en: This is tree classification, and here is the folder.
cues.zh: Decision Tree Classification，這就是資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the social network at CSV file.
cues.zh: 確認有 Social_Network_Ads.csv 檔案。

cues.en: Then you click on this more button here to set the folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 再點這裡的 More 按鈕，將資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: Then let's quickly take our template, select everything from here to the bottom, copy and paste it here.
cues.zh: 接著快速取範本，從這裡選到最下面，複製並貼到這裡。

cues.en: All right, and now let's change a few things.
cues.zh: 好，現在改幾個地方。

cues.en: So just not to forget, let's change the titles in the plot.
cues.zh: 先改圖中的標題，免得忘記。

cues.en: So we will replace classifier by decision tree and here as well.
cues.zh: 把 classifier 換成 Decision Tree，這裡也一樣。

cues.en: Okay, and now let's create our classifier.
cues.zh: 好，現在建立分類器。

cues.en: So in R, to create a decision tree classifier we will use again, the most popular library for that, which is the R part library.
cues.zh: 在 R 中建立決策樹分類器，一樣用最熱門的函式庫，也就是 rpart。

cues.en: So now just check to see if you have the R part library in your packages.
cues.zh: 先確認套件中有沒有 rpart。

cues.en: So for example, mine is right here.
cues.zh: 例如我的就在這裡。

cues.en: It might not be the case for you if you're starting R for the first time.
cues.zh: 如果你第一次用 R，可能沒有。

cues.en: So I'll just write this line of code for those of you who need to install it.
cues.zh: 所以我會寫這行程式碼，給需要安裝的人。

cues.en: And so as usual, it's install packages.
cues.zh: 一樣使用 install.packages。

cues.en: And then in quotes, in the parenthesis, you input the name of the package, which is then R part.
cues.zh: 在小括號中的引號裡輸入套件名稱，也就是 rpart。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And then to install the package you need to select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 要安裝套件，就選取並執行這行。

cues.en: I won't do it right now, because my package is already installed.
cues.zh: 我現在不執行，因為已經安裝好了。

cues.en: So I'll just put that as comment.
cues.zh: 先把它設為註解。

cues.en: And however, we're going to include this line of code here, library, and in parenthesis R part, to automatically select this library,
cues.zh: 不過要加入這行程式碼 library(rpart)，自動載入函式庫，

cues.en: because once this is executed, this will be selected.
cues.zh: 因為執行後，這裡就會選取。

cues.en: As you can see right now, it's not selected but it will be once this is executed.
cues.zh: 可以看到現在還沒勾選，執行後就會。

cues.en: Okay, and now we are ready to create R classifier.
cues.zh: 好，現在準備建立分類器。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: Classifier as usual, equals, and then we are gonna use actually a function which is the same as the library, R part.
cues.zh: 一樣是 classifier 等於，接著使用與函式庫同名的函式 rpart。

cues.en: So R part.
cues.zh: 所以寫 rpart。

cues.en: And in this function, we will input the right parameters.
cues.zh: 在函式中輸入正確參數。

cues.en: So well, as you can see right now, we can see what those parameters are.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到有哪些參數。

cues.en: But if you want more info, we can click here and press F1.
cues.zh: 如果想知道更多，可以點這裡、按 F1。

cues.en: And here we just need to click here to get some info about R part.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要點一下，就能取得 rpart 的資訊。

cues.en: Okay, so as we can see, the first argument is formula.
cues.zh: 好，可以看到第一個引數是 formula。

cues.en: And as usual, we're gonna write a formula equals dependent variable tilde dot.
cues.zh: 一樣寫 formula 等於應變數、波浪號、句點。

cues.en: So that's the same as usual.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣。

cues.en: And then we have the data argument here, which is of course the data on which you want to train new classifier.
cues.zh: 接著是 data 引數，當然就是想用來訓練新分類器的資料。

cues.en: So this data will be the training set.
cues.zh: 所以 data 是訓練集。

cues.en: All right, so let's input the argument.
cues.zh: 好，輸入引數。

cues.en: So remember the first argument was formula equals purchased.
cues.zh: 記得第一個是 formula 等於 Purchased。

cues.en: That's the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這是應變數。

cues.en: Tilde, I just pressed Alt N, and then a dot to include all the independent variables.
cues.zh: 波浪號，我剛按 Alt + N，再加句點，包含全部自變數。

cues.en: Then Comma, and then we input the second argument, which remembered was data, and we pick R training set.
cues.zh: 接著逗號，輸入第二個引數，記得是 data，選擇訓練集。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now let's execute the whole code.
cues.zh: 現在執行全部程式碼。

cues.en: So first we execute this pre-processing part here, as usual.
cues.zh: 先和往常一樣執行前處理部分。

cues.en: Done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So we can have a look at the data set, data set all find, with our two independent variables age and estimated salary and our dependent variable purchased training set.
cues.zh: 可以看看資料集，一切正常，有兩個自變數 Age 與 EstimatedSalary，以及應變數 Purchased。再看訓練集。

cues.en: All good, and test set.
cues.zh: 正常，接著測試集。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 也正常。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So the training set and the test set are scaled, because we will plot the prediction regions with a high resolution.
cues.zh: 訓練集與測試集都已縮放，因為要用高解析度繪製預測區域。

cues.en: So we need to scale.
cues.zh: 所以需要縮放。

cues.en: Actually you can try to not scale the independent variables here.
cues.zh: 其實可以試著不縮放這裡的自變數。

cues.en: You know, because for decision tree, you don't need to scale your independent variables because the decision tree model is not based on euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 因為決策樹不需要縮放自變數，它並不依據歐氏距離。

cues.en: But since we wanna plot the prediction regions with a high resolution, you will see that your code will execute a huge time faster than if you don't scale it.
cues.zh: 但要用高解析度繪製預測區域，縮放後程式碼會比不縮放快非常多。

cues.en: Actually, I think that if you don't scale it, your code might break.
cues.zh: 其實我想，不縮放甚至可能讓程式碼出錯。

cues.en: You can try that, but be careful.
cues.zh: 你可以試，但要小心。

cues.en: So we will do it, but then we will execute the code again without the scaling to plot the tree.
cues.zh: 所以我們會縮放，不過之後要繪製樹時，會重新執行不含縮放的程式碼。

cues.en: So we will clear everything, and in the preprocessing part, select everything except the feature scaling.
cues.zh: 清空所有內容，再選取前處理部分，排除特徵縮放。

cues.en: And then we will plot our tree in a very simple way.
cues.zh: 接著用很簡單的方式畫出樹。

cues.en: But right now we wanna plot the prediction regions so we scale our independent variables.
cues.zh: 但目前要畫預測區域，所以先縮放自變數。

cues.en: Okay, so perfect.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: Now the class value is ready, so let's execute it.
cues.zh: 現在分類器準備好了，執行它。

cues.en: All right, all good.
cues.zh: 好，一切正常。

cues.en: Now we can execute this line to predicted test set results.
cues.zh: 現在執行這一行，預測測試集結果。

cues.en: And actually what's funny is that y-pred is not the same as what we were used to.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，y_pred 與之前習慣的不同。

cues.en: First, for example, we can see y-pred here.
cues.zh: 首先，例如這裡可以看到 y_pred。

cues.en: Remember before, y-pred wasn't in the data here we had to type it in a console to have a look at it.
cues.zh: 記得之前 y_pred 不在這裡的資料區，要在主控台輸入才能查看。

cues.en: And here it's here.
cues.zh: 現在就在這裡。

cues.en: So let's click on it to find out what it is.
cues.zh: 點它，看看是什麼。

cues.en: All right, this is y-pred, and this is actually a matrix of two columns and a hundred lines.
cues.zh: 好，這是 y_pred，其實是有兩欄、一百列的矩陣。

cues.en: So what is this new y-pred?
cues.zh: 這個新的 y_pred 是什麼？

cues.en: What is it exactly?
cues.zh: 究竟是什麼？

cues.en: Well, as you can see, the sum of the two cells here in each line is equal to one.
cues.zh: 可以看到，每列這兩格的總和等於 1。

cues.en: So can you guess what it is?
cues.zh: 猜得到是什麼嗎？

cues.en: Well, these are probabilities.
cues.zh: 這些是機率。

cues.en: The first column gives the probability that the observation the user belongs to class zero, that is doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 第一欄是觀測值，也就是使用者屬於類別 0 的機率，代表不會購買 SUV。

cues.en: And this probability in the second column is the probability that the user buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 第二欄則是使用者會購買 SUV 的機率。

cues.en: So here, if we look at the first observation we can see that there is a very high probability that the user buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 所以看第一筆觀測值，可以看到使用者購買 SUV 的機率很高。

cues.en: And so that means here that the prediction here is that the user doesn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 因此這裡的預測是使用者不會購買 SUV。

cues.en: And if we look at the test set here and look at the index zero, we can see that indeed, in reality the user didn't buy the SUV and therefore the prediction is correct.
cues.zh: 查看測試集這裡的索引零，可以看到使用者實際確實沒有購買 SUV，所以預測正確。
